scope.summary: Seed and prove archetypes ARCH-D and ARCH-E per Section 13.27 acceptance archetypes: ARCH-D — large natural droopy tits on a fat/obese female body (REQ-014 fat-distribution channels at production quality); ARCH-E — obese male build; both mesh-collapse-free at bake level with the decouple matrix green.
acceptance_criteria: BRC-ARCH-D sets large breast volume + heavy natural droop ptosis + soft firmness on obese female fat-distribution channels (belly/apron, rolls, love handles, back fat, arm/thigh fat per REQ-014).
BRC-ARCH-E sets the obese male build from the male fat-distribution preset with the masc continuum channel; belly/chest fat channels at production values.
Both bodies evaluate at bake level with no mesh collapse, no self-intersecting rolls beyond tolerance, and volume-preservation active where fat channels stack (REQ-007).
BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID green on both: fat channels wrote only within their masks and did not collapse breast/glute volumes (REQ-016 exclusion honored in reverse).
Both recipes deterministic and registered in the QA iterator.
scope.risk_if_missed: Fat/obese bodies — explicitly named operator production targets that Daz handles poorly — ship as untested channel math and fail at the first real production render.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
